title: Prints
lede: Woodcut, linocut and engraving prints traced from the woodcuts mood board: pomegranates, oak leaves and acorns, pinecones, hanging fruit, round flowers, a lily, wildflowers, tulips, a flowering branch, a mountain range with and without a gold sun, and a flock of swallows. Each as an SVG and a transparent 1000px PNG.
use_for: Printed texture at size: covers, grounds under a transparency, the podcast flock.
colour_rule: As printed: never retint them to the illustration inks. Often used under a transparency; keep it subtle. The gold sun and the pale-yellow branch are kept by choice.

elements.title: Flock of swallows
elements.desc: About eleven barn swallows rising in a loose diagonal flock, in fine 19th-century engraving line: hatched wings, stippled breasts, white throats. Our main motif. Fine line, so use it large.

elements.title: Pomegranates
elements.desc: Two pomegranates, one whole and one cut open, as a two-colour linocut: black key block over a flat red that sits slightly out of register.

elements.title: Oak leaf and acorn on a twig
elements.desc: One oak leaf and one acorn on a sweeping twig. Solid black, thin cut veins, cut-out acorn cup.

elements.title: Acorn
elements.desc: A single acorn with a ribbed nut, speckled cap and stray gouge marks around the edge.
elements.source: Mood board 10: Stock linocut set (watermarked, draft)

elements.title: Oak leaf, down-right
elements.desc: An oak leaf angled down and to the right, with white cut veins and stray cuts.
elements.source: Mood board 10: Stock linocut set (watermarked, draft)

elements.title: Oak leaf, up-right
elements.desc: An oak leaf angled up and to the right, with white cut veins and stray cuts.
elements.source: Mood board 10: Stock linocut set (watermarked, draft)

elements.title: Two acorns with an oak leaf
elements.desc: A pair of acorns with crosshatched cups and a small oak leaf above.
elements.source: Mood board 10: Stock linocut set (watermarked, draft)

elements.title: Pinecone, bold
elements.desc: A tilted pinecone in strong black and white, with chunky outlined scales that go ragged at the tip.

elements.title: Pinecone hanging from a twig
elements.desc: A pinecone hanging from a pine twig with long, fine needles. A thin pen drawing, best used large.

elements.title: Hanging fruit and leaves
elements.desc: Two round fruit with leaf clusters as a cut-paper silhouette. Thin white gaps do the drawing. Vertical, so it suits a margin or divider.

elements.title: Round flowers on a branching stem
elements.desc: Pom-pom flower heads on a long, thin branching stem. Light and airy, with heavy dots on a hairline.

elements.title: Tulips in loose brush line
elements.desc: Five tulip-like flowers in loose, tapering brush strokes. Source image was AI-generated, so mood reference.

elements.title: Lily stem
elements.desc: A lily stem in a few swelling brush lines, with leaves left partly open.

elements.title: Wildflowers
elements.desc: Three wildflowers and two buds in scratchy pen line with dark centres. Clip-art crop, so a draft.

elements.title: Flowering branch, cropped
elements.desc: A flowering branch as a flat silhouette, cropped so it runs off the frame. Works as a background or tile.

elements.title: Mountain range with a gold sun
elements.desc: A range of three peaks carved in strong black and white, with short cut strokes for the plain below and a small gold sun above.
elements.source: Mood board 21: Pinterest linocut with gold leaf

elements.title: Mountain range
elements.desc: The same range of peaks without the sun, cropped tight to the mountains and the plain.
elements.source: Mood board 21: Pinterest linocut with gold leaf
